summary.value: Also known as Pellar, Wise Woman, Greenway Pathfinder.

system.description:
Built on Project FU's Feyweaver.

FREE BENEFITS
  • Ritualism rituals — activated.

(House note: FU auto-applies this class benefit — the mechanical field is activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise; the benefit itself is standard Project FU.)

CUNNING FOLK SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000083]{Fey's Blessing} 【Max SL 5】

Action + 10 MP: offer a blessing to your allies — never yourself — each freely refusing or accepting. Each accepter gains +(SL × 3) HP/MP recovery and −(SL) damage taken until scene's end, and owes a gift you name, due before their next rest — or the blessing turns curse: −(SL × 3) recovery and +(SL) damage taken until that rest.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000084]{Fey's Debt} 【Max SL 1】

Ask an ally or NPC a favour — no cost, no action. If they accept and fulfil it, you owe them on their terms, under a GM-set penalty until repaid. The favour may always be refused, and an unfulfillable ask costs nothing.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000085]{Fey Crossing} 【Max SL 1】

See the hidden gates of the fairy paths — shortcuts with a price. Deliberately numberless: form, destination and consequences are the GM's, ruled once per campaign (here: Risky Passage — each use carries a minor cost or complication).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000086]{Fairy Magic} 【Max SL 3】

Each level attunes one element (of eight) among spells you know; its fey effect rides those spells free: air lifts an ally into flight for a turn, bolt lets an ally act right after you, fire adds a burn next turn, ice shields an ally for −5 damage, poison poisons — and dark, earth and light each deny one action type (Ranged, Melee, Spell) for the target's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000087]{Manaflow} 【Max SL 5】

Whenever you recover Mind Points, recover an additional (SL × 4) — any source, no limit.
